newsitem.title: USA: Queens County Bancorp sets 3-for-2 split.
newsitem.headline: Queens County Bancorp sets 3-for-2 split.

text.p: Queens County Bancorp Inc said directors declared a three-for-two stock split in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend payable on April 10 to shareholders of record March 17.

Chief executive Joseph R. Ficalora noted the company has now split its stock three times since public trading began in November 1993. "Like the stock splits which preceded it, this split is intended to enhance the value of our shareholders' investment while also enhancing our liquidity."
The company said it now has about 7.6 million shares outstanding. This will increase to about 11.4 million after the split, it said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
